exclusion_mechanisms: openpyxl is namespace-blind: it reads the main data-validation namespace and discards the x14 extension (ingest/competence.py, measured on all nine workbooks at P1)
openpyxl returns an ArrayFormula object rather than the formula text for an array formula (ingest/competence.py, measured on all nine workbooks at P1)

refused_transformations: U+2010, U+2011, U+2013 and U+002D stay distinct. Folding them would make a homoglyph substitution unlocatable BY THE GATE THAT EXISTS TO CATCH IT
an identifier's case is part of it; folding would make two different cell references one unit
U+2018/U+2019 and U+201C/U+201D stay distinct from U+0027 and U+0022 for the same reason as the dashes
